description: A named set of requirements, all of which must pass, applied with `RequireAuthorization("Name")` or `[Authorize(Policy = "Name")]`.
The policy used by `RequireAuthorization()` or `[Authorize]` without a name, which requires an authenticated user unless the app changes it.
The policy applied to endpoints with no authorization metadata, `null` by default, and set to require an authenticated user for a deny-by-default API.
A class implementing the marker interface `IAuthorizationRequirement` that holds the data of one rule, such as a minimum age or an allowed time window.
A class deriving from `AuthorizationHandler<TRequirement>` that calls `context.Succeed(requirement)` when the rule is met; several handlers for one requirement combine with OR.
Imperative authorization that loads the record first and calls `IAuthorizationService.AuthorizeAsync(user, resource, policy)`, because attributes run before data is loaded.
The OWASP API1:2023 risk of letting an authenticated caller access another user's object by changing an id in the request.
